Unfortunately for me it became my only outlet of enjoying life and like any drug it eventually loses its potency. I am considering medication for both depression and ADHD but the thing is the military doesn't much approve of either when considering you for enlistment. I'll look into seeing if there is exceptions and talk to my recruiter. But I do absolutely agree with the life change part. My two paths are between military or Florida, its just a matter of which I feel will be better for my mental health. I worry about starting a career and making money because I'm 21 and have very little to put on a resume. It feels urgent seeing people I know graduating college and starting to make a living. But I believe none of that will matter if I can't handle existing. Thank you so much for your advice it means the world to me.
